entries:
Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.
Build Python inference services in Taipei.
Discuss model limitations with product colleagues.
Explain latency and accuracy trade-offs.

capabilities.description: Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.
capabilities.evidence: Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.

capabilities.description: Build Python inference services in Taipei.
capabilities.evidence: Build Python inference services in Taipei.

capabilities.description: Discuss model limitations with product colleagues.
capabilities.evidence: Discuss model limitations with product colleagues.

questions.text: What motivates you to work on retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant?
questions.meaningZh: 是什麼激勵你從事中文支援助理的檢索品質工作？
questions.rationale: This probes your motivation for the role’s stated retrieval-quality focus.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在探查你對該職位所強調之檢索品質重點的動機。
questions.evidence: Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.

questions.text: How would you decide whether building Python inference services in Taipei aligns with your interests and working preferences?
questions.meaningZh: 你會如何判斷在台北建置 Python 推論服務是否符合你的興趣與工作偏好？
questions.rationale: This checks alignment with the role’s stated technical work and location.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在確認你是否認同該職位所描述的技術工作與地點。
questions.evidence: Build Python inference services in Taipei.

questions.text: Describe a retrieval-quality evaluation you have performed, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請描述你曾進行過的檢索品質評估；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: This assesses practical depth in evaluating retrieval quality without assuming prior experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在評估你進行檢索品質評估的實務深度，但不預設你已有相關經驗。
questions.evidence: Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.

questions.text: Walk me through how you would design a Python inference service for a Mandarin support assistant, including the first concrete constraint you would address.
questions.meaningZh: 請逐步說明你會如何為中文支援助理設計 Python 推論服務，包括你會優先處理的第一個具體限制。
questions.rationale: This tests whether you can turn the service requirement into a concrete implementation approach.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在測試你是否能將服務需求轉化為具體的實作方法。
questions.evidence: Build Python inference services in Taipei.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you explained a model limitation to a product colleague, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請告訴我一次你向產品同事說明模型限制的經驗；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: This evaluates your ability to communicate model limitations in a product setting without presupposing experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在評估你在產品情境中溝通模型限制的能力，但不預設你已有相關經驗。
questions.evidence: Discuss model limitations with product colleagues.

questions.text: Imagine that product colleagues disagree with your assessment of a model limitation. How would you discuss the issue constructively?
questions.meaningZh: 假設產品同事不同意你對模型限制的評估，你會如何建設性地討論這個問題？
questions.rationale: This probes how you handle disagreement while discussing model limitations with product colleagues.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在探查你如何在與產品同事討論模型限制時處理意見分歧。
questions.evidence: Discuss model limitations with product colleagues.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you made a latency-versus-accuracy trade-off, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請告訴我一次你在延遲與準確度之間做出取捨的經驗；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: This assesses whether you can reason about the central performance trade-off in the role.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在評估你是否能推理該職位核心的效能取捨。
questions.evidence: Explain latency and accuracy trade-offs.

questions.text: If product colleagues ask for higher accuracy without accepting more latency, how would you respond?
questions.meaningZh: 如果產品同事要求更高的準確度，卻不接受更高的延遲，你會如何回應？
questions.rationale: This tests your approach to explaining competing performance goals under a realistic constraint.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在測試你如何在現實限制下說明相互競爭的效能目標。
questions.evidence: Explain latency and accuracy trade-offs.

questions.text: How would you explain a retrieval-quality result and its implications to product colleagues who are not specialists in machine learning?
questions.meaningZh: 你會如何向非機器學習專業的產品同事解釋檢索品質結果及其影響？
questions.rationale: This probes your ability to make retrieval-quality findings understandable to product colleagues.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在探查你是否能讓產品同事理解檢索品質的發現。
questions.evidence: Evaluate retrieval quality for a Mandarin support assistant.

questions.text: How would you explain a latency and accuracy trade-off to product colleagues using a simple example?
questions.meaningZh: 你會如何使用簡單的例子向產品同事解釋延遲與準確度之間的取捨？
questions.rationale: This evaluates whether you can communicate a technical trade-off clearly to product stakeholders.
questions.rationaleZh: 這是在評估你是否能向產品利害關係人清楚傳達技術取捨。
questions.evidence: Explain latency and accuracy trade-offs.

entries:
Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.
Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.
Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.
Explain consistency and availability trade-offs.

capabilities.description: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.
capabilities.evidence: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.

capabilities.description: Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.
capabilities.evidence: Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.

capabilities.description: Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.
capabilities.evidence: Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.

capabilities.description: Reliability likely includes explicit handling of failure scenarios in payment APIs.
capabilities.evidence: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.

capabilities.description: The role likely expects clear explanations of distributed-systems trade-offs.

questions.text: What interests you about building reliable payment APIs in Taipei, and what does reliability mean to you in this domain?
questions.meaningZh: 是什麼吸引你在臺北打造可靠的支付 API？在這個領域中，可靠性對你而言代表什麼？
questions.rationale: Assesses motivation for the payment domain, location, and the candidate’s definition of reliability.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人對支付領域與工作地點的動機，以及其對可靠性的定義。
questions.evidence: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.

questions.text: Design a reliable payment API and explain how you would handle retries, duplicate requests, and partial failures.
questions.meaningZh: 請設計一個可靠的支付 API，並說明你會如何處理重試、重複請求與部分失敗。
questions.rationale: Assesses whether the candidate can turn a reliability goal into concrete API failure-handling decisions.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人是否能將可靠性目標轉化為具體的 API 失敗處理決策。
questions.evidence: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.

questions.text: How would you choose PostgreSQL transaction boundaries to preserve data correctness while avoiding unnecessary locking or latency?
questions.meaningZh: 你會如何選擇 PostgreSQL 交易邊界，在維持資料正確性的同時避免不必要的鎖定或延遲？
questions.rationale: Assesses practical reasoning about transaction boundaries and database trade-offs.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人對交易邊界與資料庫取捨的實務推理能力。
questions.evidence: Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.

questions.text: For a payment API, which automated tests would you create, and how would you decide the scope of unit, integration, and end-to-end tests?
questions.meaningZh: 針對支付 API，你會建立哪些自動化測試？你會如何決定單元、整合與端對端測試的範圍？
questions.rationale: Assesses test strategy across levels for payment behavior.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人針對支付行為制定各層級測試策略的能力。
questions.evidence: Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.

questions.text: Describe a project in which you used PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請描述一個你使用 PostgreSQL 交易與自動化測試的專案；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: Tests depth of hands-on experience while allowing a hypothetical answer because no experience is assumed.
questions.rationaleZh: 測試實作經驗的深度，同時因未假設候選人具備相關經驗而允許以假設情境回答。
questions.evidence: Use PostgreSQL transactions and automated tests.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you participated in an incident review without blaming individuals, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請分享一次你在不責怪個人的前提下參與事件檢討的經驗；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: Assesses blameless incident-review behavior without assuming prior incident experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人進行無責備事件檢討的行為方式，而不假設其具備過往事件經驗。
questions.evidence: Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.

questions.text: If someone began blaming a specific colleague during an incident review, how would you respond and move the discussion back toward system improvement?
questions.meaningZh: 如果有人在事件檢討中開始責怪特定同事，你會如何回應，並將討論帶回系統改進？
questions.rationale: Assesses whether the candidate can redirect blame toward systemic learning.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人是否能將責備轉向系統性學習。
questions.evidence: Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.

questions.text: Explain the trade-off between consistency and availability to a product manager who is unfamiliar with distributed systems, and give an example of how you would choose.
questions.meaningZh: 請向不熟悉分散式系統的產品經理解釋一致性與可用性之間的取捨，並舉例說明你會如何選擇。
questions.rationale: Assesses clarity when explaining distributed-systems trade-offs to a non-specialist.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人向非專業人士解釋分散式系統取捨時的清晰度。
questions.evidence: Explain consistency and availability trade-offs.

questions.text: If a payment request timed out after the database commit, how would you analyze the situation and design the API behavior to prevent duplicate charges?
questions.meaningZh: 如果支付請求在資料庫提交後逾時，你會如何分析情況，並設計 API 行為以避免重複扣款？
questions.rationale: Assesses reasoning about timeout ambiguity, transaction state, and duplicate-payment prevention.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人對逾時不確定性、交易狀態與防止重複扣款的推理能力。
questions.evidence: Build reliable payment APIs in Taipei.

questions.text: Describe a time you disagreed with an incident-review conclusion while preserving a blameless process, or how would you approach this if you have not encountered it?
questions.meaningZh: 請描述一次你不同意事件檢討結論、但仍維持無責備流程的經驗；如果你沒有遇過這種情況，你會如何處理？
questions.rationale: Assesses respectful disagreement and collaborative incident-review practices without assuming prior experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 評估候選人尊重地處理分歧及協作進行事件檢討的方式，而不假設其具備過往經驗。
questions.evidence: Collaborate on incident reviews without blame.
